high_level_description: The image shows a man standing outdoors, facing away from the camera towards a body of water. The man is wearing a black cap with yellow embroidery on the side, which appears to be some form of insignia or logo. He also has large over-ear headphones on his head, suggesting he might be listening to something or communicating through them. The man is dressed in a dark-colored jacket, and he has a beard. In the background, there are several ships visible on the water, indicating that the location might be near a harbor or naval base.
